subject.title: [Feature]: Make workboard dispatch maxStarts configurable and parallelize per-card start loop

question: Should Workboard dispatch throughput control stop at an explicit CLI/RPC maxStarts parameter, or should OpenClaw also add persistent config defaults and parallel per-card starts?
rationale: The source-reproducible gap is real, but persistent config and concurrent subagent starts change operator resource policy beyond a strict bug fix.

options.title: Land narrow CLI/RPC threading first
options.body: Accept the explicit maxStarts flag/RPC parameter path while leaving persistent defaults and parallel starts for a separately approved follow-up.

options.title: Approve the full throughput feature
options.body: Implement CLI/RPC/config maxStarts plus bounded parallel starts with upgrade and host-resource proof before closing the issue.

options.title: Decline config and concurrency expansion
options.body: Keep the default cap and sequential behavior as intentional resource protection, documenting the supported dispatch model instead.

recommendation.title: Land narrow CLI/RPC threading first
recommendation.body: Accept the explicit maxStarts flag/RPC parameter path while leaving persistent defaults and parallel starts for a separately approved follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Workboard worker dispatch PR and current path history make this the strongest available routing candidate for the resource-policy choice.
